confidence_notes: Food estimates use Japan-wide aggregated prices checked against Matsuyama consumer-price statistics. Accommodation is a holistic estimate; cocktail and wine prices are inferred from the local draft-beer level and are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Japan-wide restaurant benchmarks adjusted for Matsuyama's regional-city context, with local consumer-price statistics as a check. Lodging estimates reflect a midsize Japanese city with Dogo Onsen tourism.
